newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX and HKFE to have trading link from June 12.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX and HKFE to have trading link from June 12.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Monday that it would begin an electronic trading link with the Hong Kong Futures Exchange (HKFE) on June 12 at 1600 EDT/2000 GMT.

The link was agreed last September and will provide HKFE members with direct access to NYMEX products, including crude oil, gold silver, copper, heating oil, gasoline, natural gas, propane and electricity during the hours they are electronically traded, NYMEX said in a press release.

"This link represents the initial phase of a long-term relationship which is likely to result in a series of NYMEX/HKFE jointly sponsored contracts tailored to the needs of the Asia-Pacific region," said HKFE chief executive Ivers Riely.
